_note: AS5600 12-bit magnetic rotary position sensor module (ams-OSRAM). I2C interface, fixed address 0x36. 6-pin breakout: VCC, GND, SDA, SCL on bottom; OUT (analog/PWM output, configurable), DIR (direction select: GND=CW increasing, VCC=CCW increasing) on top. 12-bit angle resolution (0.087 deg), contactless Hall effect sensing via diametrically magnetized magnet above the IC. Programmable start/stop angles, hysteresis, and output mode (analog 0-100% VCC or PWM).
